taxonomy:
# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Puzzles

## I. By Primary Task Type

### A. Loop/Path Drawing
Puzzles where the solver draws a single continuous loop or path through the grid.

#### A1. Pure Loop Construction
- **Masyu** – Loop constrained by black/white circle turning rules
- **Slitherlink** – Loop drawn on grid edges, constrained by number clues
- **Mid-loop** – Loop where black circles must be midpoints of straight segments
- **Nagareru** – Directed loop with wind constraints
- **Moon-or-Sun** – Loop alternating between moon/sun symbols across rooms
- **Suraromu** – Loop starting/ending at numbered circle, passing through gates in order
- **Dotchi-Loop** – Loop constrained by white circles (all straight or all turning per region) and avoiding black circles

#### A2. Loop with Cell Shading
- **Yajilin** – Loop drawn while also placing black cells indicated by arrow clues

#### A3. Path/Connection Drawing
- **Numberlink** – Connect pairs of identical numbers with non-crossing paths
- **Hashiwokakero** – Connect island nodes with bridges (1 or 2) to form a connected network

### B. Cell Shading/Painting
Puzzles where the solver colors certain cells black (or leaves them white).

#### B1. Shading with Number Clues (counting adjacent/nearby black cells)
- **Akari** – Place light bulbs; numbers count adjacent bulbs; all white cells illuminated
- **Kurotto** – Numbers in circles indicate sum of sizes of adjacent black cell groups
- **Kurodoko** – Numbers indicate count of visible white cells in four directions
- **Nurikabe** – Numbers define white island sizes; black cells form connected wall with no 2×2
- **Usowan** – Numbers count adjacent black cells, but one number per room is wrong

#### B2. Shading with Regional Constraints
- **Heyawake** – Numbers indicate black cell count per room; white cells connected; no white line spans 3+ rooms
- **Norinori** – Exactly two black cells per region, each black cell part of a domino
- **Nurimisaki** – Circle cells are white promontories; no 2×2 of same color; white connected
- **Nurimeizu** – Rooms entirely black or white; creates maze from S to G with shortest-path constraints
- **Nuritwin** – Each region has exactly two same-sized shaded blocks; all shading connected; no 2×2
- **LITS** – Place one tetromino per region; same-shape tetrominoes don't touch; connected; no 2×2
- **Sto-stone** – Black cells per room given by number; when "dropped" they fill bottom half of grid
- **Tilepaint** – Entire tiles colored or not; diagonal clue cells give row/column black cell counts

#### B3. Shading to Form Geometric Shapes
- **Choco Banana** – Black groups must be rectangles/squares; white groups must not be rectangles/squares
- **Shakashaka** – Place triangles so remaining white areas form rectangles/squares

#### B4. Shading with Connectivity/Adjacency Rules (no number placement)
- **Chained Block** – Black blocks with size numbers; all blocks chained diagonally; unique shapes per chain

### C. Number/Symbol Placement
Puzzles where the solver fills cells with numbers or symbols.

#### C1. Latin Square Variants
- **Sudoku** – Place 1–9 in rows, columns, and 3×3 boxes
- **Hitori** – Eliminate duplicates in rows/columns by blackening cells; black cells non-adjacent; white connected

#### C2. Region-Based Number Fill
- **Fillomino** – Divide grid into polyomino blocks; each block filled with its size number; same-size blocks don't touch
- **Ripple Effect** – Rooms filled with 1 to N; repeated numbers in a line must be spaced apart by at least that number
- **Makaro** – Rooms filled with 1 to N; arrow cells point to the largest neighbor; no same number adjacent across rooms
- **Nansuke** – Fill blank cells with digits to place given multi-digit numbers from a list

#### C3. Symbol Placement
- **Juosan** – Fill every cell with — or |; territory clues give difference counts; limited consecutive same-orientation runs

### D. Grid Division/Partitioning
Puzzles where the solver divides the grid into regions.

#### D1. Division into Specified Shapes
- **Shikaku** – Divide into rectangles; each contains exactly one number equal to its area
- **Five Cells** – Divide into pentominoes; numbers count surrounding block edges
- **Sashigane** – Divide into L-shaped blocks; circles mark bends; arrows mark ends

#### D2. Division with Matching Constraints
- **Double Choco** – Divide so each block has matching white and gray sub-regions of identical shape

### E. Object Placement/Movement
Puzzles where the solver places or moves discrete objects.

#### E1. Placement
- **Akari** – Place light bulbs (also in shading category due to illumination)
- **Evolomino** – Place growing polyomino blocks along arrow paths
- **Pencils** – Identify pencil shapes and draw lines from their tips

#### E2. Movement
- **Satogaeri** – Move circles within countries so each country has exactly one; movement distance given
- **Yosenabe** – Move circles straight into gray areas; numbers in gray areas equal sum of entering circles

---

## II. By Constraint Mechanism

### Connectivity Constraints
White/black cells must form connected networks:
Akari, Hitori, Kurodoko, Nurikabe, Heyawake, Nurimisaki, Nurimeizu, Nuritwin, LITS, Usowan

### No 2×2 Constraint
No 2×2 block of same color allowed:
Nurikabe, Nurimisaki, Nurimeizu, Nuritwin, LITS, Sto-stone

### Adjacency/Non-adjacency of Black Cells
Black cells may not share edges:
Hitori, Kurodoko, Usowan, Yajilin, Norinori (opposite: must form dominoes)

### Directional/Arrow Clues
Clues with arrows indicating direction:
Yajilin, Hebi, Makaro, Nagareru, Yosenabe, Evolomino, Sashigane

### Room/Region-Based Clues
Grid pre-divided into rooms with constraints per room:
Heyawake, Makaro, Ripple Effect, Moon-or-Sun, Dotchi-Loop, Double Choco, Norinori, Nurimeizu, Nuritwin, Sto-stone, Suraromu, Tilepaint, Usowan, Five Cells

### Visibility/Line-of-Sight Clues
Numbers count cells or objects visible in straight lines:
Akari (illumination), Kurodoko (white cell count), Hebi (snake visibility), Nurimisaki (white line length)

---

## III. By Grid Element Used for Clues

### Numbers in Cells
Sudoku, Fillomino, Ripple Effect, Makaro, Hitori, Nansuke, Shikaku, Five Cells, Choco Banana, Chained Block, Sto-stone, Heyawake, Nurikabe, Kurodoko, Yajilin, Usowan, Tilepaint, Pencils, Evolomino, Hebi, Yosenabe, Satogaeri, Sashigane

### Circles (with or without numbers)
Kurotto, Nurimisaki, Masyu, Dotchi-Loop, Mid-loop, Hashiwokakero, Satogaeri, Suraromu, Yosenabe, Akari (light bulbs)

### Arrows
Yajilin, Makaro, Hebi, Nagareru, Evolomino, Sashigane

### Moon/Sun Symbols
Moon-or-Sun

### Bold-Line Regions (pre-divided rooms)
Heyawake, Makaro, Ripple Effect, Dotchi-Loop, Double Choco, Moon-or-Sun, Norinori, Nurimeizu, Nuritwin, Sto-stone, Suraromu, Tilepaint, Usowan, Five Cells, Juosan

### Dots on Grid Intersections
Slitherlink
